title: Outcome dashboard for accepted docs + reuse events
context: A dashboard that reads the outcome ledger and surfaces accepted documentation and verified reuse events to support the project's outcome-based success metrics. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Code is MIT-licensed; reads only committed ledger/outcome artifacts, never inspected data.
objective: Build an outcome dashboard that reads the outcome ledger and displays accepted datasheets and verified external reuse events.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard reads the committed outcome ledger / outcomes/<dataset-id>.json artifacts and lists accepted documentation and verified reuse events.
Surfaces the project success metrics (accepted count per source, reuse events, completeness, effort trend) from verifiable evidence only.
Code MIT-licensed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint green with fixtures; DCO signed-off; no credentials or inspected data committed.
